---

## 💡 What This Folder Is For

The fill-in reference pages: the ones a reader opens to look one thing up, and
then closes. The glossary comes first, because every other document leans on
the words it defines. Each decision is marked by `[square brackets]` until your
project makes it.

Copy a file out to `docs/references/` under the same name, then replace every
bracket. The seed here stays pristine.

Terms every repository on the standards shares are already defined in the
shared [Glossary](https://github.com/tannergolden/standards/blob/Development/docs/references/Glossary.md).
Your copy defines only what this project means by its own words, and links
there for the rest.
